title: Remove duplicate log entries
brief: The server log has repeated error lines. Keep only unique consecutive lines to reduce noise.
text:
ERROR: timeout
ERROR: timeout
INFO: retry
INFO: retry
ERROR: timeout

expect.text:
ERROR: timeout
INFO: retry
ERROR: timeout

why: The global command with a backreference \1 matches a line followed by an identical next line, deleting only the duplicate while preserving non-consecutive repeats.
author: claude (daily)
hint: Use :g with a pattern that captures a line and matches it again on the next line.
